Functional Modules

Engineered With Complete Operational Modules

Everything required to coordinate frontline operators, parts inventory, accounting, and customer communication in StayHub PMS.

Interactive Availability Matrix

Color-coded visual calendar displaying occupied, reserved, vacant, and dirty rooms or individual hostel bunk beds.

Dual Mode: Hotel vs Hostel Allocation

Switch between daily room rate bookings for hotel guests and recurring monthly bed subscriptions for hostel residents.

Digital KYC & Resident Records

Attach guest photo ID, student college credentials, emergency contacts, and signed property agreements securely.

Folio Billing & Extra Services

Add laundry, cafeteria meals, extra bed charges, and parking fees directly to the room invoice with automated balance reminders.

Housekeeping & Maintenance

Assign room cleaning duties to staff and log repairs with tracking from complaint logged to task completion.

Automated Dues & WhatsApp Notices

Generate monthly rent invoices for hostel residents with one-click payment links and automatic payment reconciliation.

End-to-End Workflow

How Information Flows From Arrival to Handover

Eliminate manual bottlenecks with an automated 5-step operational pipeline.

01

Reservation / Inquiry

Log booking request via walk-in, phone, or online portal.

02

Digital Check-in & KYC

Capture guest IDs, record security deposit, and hand over keys/bed allocation.

03

In-Stay Management

Add meals, housekeeping services, and facility usage to resident folio.

04

Express Check-Out

Verify room clearance, compute final invoice, deduct deposit, and issue receipt.

Stakeholder Value

Tailored Value for Every Business Persona

Different team members interact with the software differently. Here is how each role benefits.

Property Owner

Zero room leakages, accurate occupancy forecasting, and automated revenue collection.

Front Desk Executive

Intuitive drag-and-drop booking grid and lightning-fast check-in workflows.

Warden / Manager

Hostel student attendance, gate passes, and maintenance complaint resolution logs.

Security & Role-Based Governance

Access policies can be scoped by role and workflow. The permissions needed for your team should be confirmed during product evaluation and setup.

  • Hosting and encryption controls confirmed per deployment
  • Backup and recovery arrangements defined for the selected service
  • Audit history can be scoped to relevant workflows

3 to 10-Day Implementation & Staff Onboarding

We know your business cannot stop for software upgrades. Our onboarding team provides turnkey data migration from your existing spreadsheets, hardware integration (barcode guns/printers), and live staff training.

  • Automated CSV/Excel import templates for SKU catalogs & customer databases
  • Personalized screen share training for advisors, cashiers & managers
  • Dedicated deployment manager during your first two weeks of go-live
